related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Native capability correspondences omit originating work context and source provenance
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The baseline correspondence projection retained capability and pressure identities but omitted the authenticated observation's related_work context and exact evidence pointer. The source record carries campaign, session, and environment identity while its objective fields are absent.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve bounded source work context and the exact observation reference in native capability correspondences; explicitly report when historical objective fields were not recorded, and record those fields in future observations where available.
not_measured: whether this context gap recurs across other native capability records
whether any agent discovered or used the native process API
whether the documented host boundaries were caused by the linked pressure
whether a consumer is ready to migrate

improvement_relation.basis: The projection now retains the source observation's bounded related_work fields and exact campaign evidence pointer, with a distinct status when objective fields are absent. Targeted tests verify both complete and missing objective contexts and compaction. A live campaign projection is recorded by the linked verification observation. No subsequent agent use is claimed.
not_measured: whether agents can discover or use the process API through their own runtime context
whether future source observations record their work objectives
whether this change improves native migration or consumer parity
whether the pressure recurs after this implementation

measurement_limits: The implementation improves traceability and missing-context visibility; it does not recover source objectives that were never recorded.
The selected session's current campaign charter and Work Intent remain separate and are not substituted for the originating source observation.
The relation has no subsequent observation yet, so lasting effectiveness is not established.

supporting_sources.verified_behavior: Projects bounded source work context, explicit objective capture status, and exact source observation reference.
Tests complete and absent objective context, exact source pointer retention, compaction, and exclusion of unrelated fields.
